      $server.addShare("interactsh", "/interactsh")
    languages: ["python"]
    message: "Detected addition of 'interactsh' share to SMB server in interactsh project."
    severity: ERROR

      source-url: github.com/projectdiscovery/interactsh/commit/6a0cb98b16636a98712729f3d23e34d8bf7260e7

        - https://github.com/projectdiscovery/interactsh
